opening.argument: The presentation solicits a paid entry of Rp600.000 or 600 DRX while associating that payment with X3, X4, and other slot-based returns. It urges viewers to invest TRX for the future and sell it at a higher price, including the prospect of selling the next day. The displayed opportunity also promotes developing a network, while the speaker describes profit being distributed at one level. These are direct invitations to purchase and promote an investment opportunity built around appreciation and stated returns.
